stories.title: Natural England objected to a datacentre. Weeks later ministers threatened to abolish the agency
stories.summary: Natural England urged Bristol City Council to reject a proposed 40-megawatt AI datacentre at Avonmouth because of risks to nearby protected wildlife and habitats. Weeks after the independent environmental adviser made the objection, government ministers threatened to abolish the agency.

stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Some freed Israeli women still had shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to an Israeli medical official. The official said some had been held alone for extended periods and spent eight months in tunnels.
